scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.bridge.config.ts
scripts.build:dev: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode development && vite build --mode development --config vite.bridge.config.ts
scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -f languito-extension.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../languito-extension.zip .
scripts.release: npm run zip && mkdir -p ../public/downloads && cp languito-extension.zip ../public/downloads/languito-extension.zip
